name: Chili Pot
steps: Cut the onion and garlic into small pieces.
Brown the onion and garlic in a pot until soft.
Add the minced beef and cook until browned.
Add the canned tomatoes, kidney beans, tomato paste, chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Simmer and stir the chili until you loose patience.
Serve the chili in bowls, topped with cheese and a dollop of chili mayo, and with tortillas on the side.
